Module com.example.miniproyecto_sudoku
Package com.example.miniproyecto_sudoku.model.board

Class SudokuBoardState

java.lang.Object
com.example.miniproyecto_sudoku.model.board.SudokuBoardState
All Implemented Interfaces:
ISudokuBoardState, Serializable
public class SudokuBoardState extends Object implements ISudokuBoardState, Serializable
Class that represents a saved state of a Sudoku board. Stores a copy of the board grid and the current position associated with the game state.
